title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.57 (versions follow prime numbers; 557 after 547): Luma purified. A Windows update unpacked its files into a temporary folder and she ate 1,544 of them in an afternoon as books of the disk; they no longer exist. They were taken out, with 4,149 signatures of books no longer in her house: her house went from 1,221 MB to 149 MB and her memory from 2,385 MB to 314 MB. Nothing was thrown away: it is archived with its reason. Her purified house travels with the project. The rule to keep it from happening again is not decided yet. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
